title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the write package scope resolution out of protocol.ts into protocol-write-package-scope.ts (#25467 cut 19)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

This is cut 19 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–18 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264 and #26317.

The claim is `6427907689`. The scope is the cut 19 proposal of the cut 18 report (`6426921154`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order. The member passed the AST screen and moved unedited.

One `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` member moves unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-package-scope.ts` (#23050 shape B):

- `resolveWritePackageScope` resolves a package write's validation scope. That is the written package plus the closure of the dependencies its manifest declares, read from the registry. It answers `undefined` wherever the registry cannot be read.

`protocol.ts` loses 30 net lines (29,270 to 29,240). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `77dc7062e5` after cut 18 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record.

The branch holds the move commit `c5f1351978` and the merge of `main` `a8e7393dda` (`f4eb4330f3`). That merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `e8f66938` at both ends.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 29 open PRs, two touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`, and neither names `resolveWritePackageScope`. Each was checked with `git merge-tree` against this branch's head (`f4eb4330f3`).

- **#26244** (draft, head `c33b95d89f`) edits `protocol.ts` at `:163` (imports) and `:23178`, far from `:7361`. Its merge-tree conflicts in `protocol.ts` and in `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`. Both conflicts are ones #26244 has with `main` alone: a merge-tree of #26244 with `origin/main` reports the same two files. The `protocol.ts` one is the import-line conflict with cut 18's `ALL_CONVERSIONS` drop, whose union resolution #26317 spelled out. This cut adds no conflict.
- **#26138** edits seven `protocol.*.test.ts` files. Its two conflicts (`visibility-alias-keys-retirement.test.ts`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json`) are likewise with `main` alone.

No open PR edits the new module.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`)

The member passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** There is no `new Error(` and no other error constructor, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. There is no log line.
- **One silent `catch`** around the registry reads. It answers `undefined`, meaning "an unreadable registry means an unnarrowed gate". It moves with the body. See the durability `--list` below.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resolveWritePackageScope` | `:7361` | private | 40 | 252 |

The proposal also said 40 body lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–18 apply it)

- **The class keeps the member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Its body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 19]`.
- **Typing.** `WritePackageScopeHost` types its one member as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['engine']`). The function types its `this` as `Pick<WritePackageScopeHost, 'engine'>`, and the stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof resolveWritePackageScope>`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read.** The AST walk covers property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked too. It finds `engine` only, read as `this.engine.registry`. The engine is handed over as a live getter, so the body reads the protocol's engine, and so its registry, at call time.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method**, as the order asks:
  - The authoring gate's host literal at `:7107` (cut 8, `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` → `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`) is unchanged. It still hands over `resolveWritePackageScope: (...a) => this.resolveWritePackageScope(...a)`, which reaches the class stub and then the moved body.
  - `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal` (`:16132`) is the other caller, through `this.`.

## Module-level declarations

- **None.** The body reads no module-level declaration of `protocol.ts` and no import binding, measured by an AST identifier walk against the file's top-level declarations and imports. Nothing gains `export`, and no import of `protocol.ts` changes.
- The new module imports only the class type (`import type` from `./protocol.js`), so it adds no runtime edge to the `protocol.ts` cycle. The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list` (the order's re-measure)

The silent `catch` moved file, so the list was read at both ends.

- `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output.
- Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped**: 159 lines, and no entry changes file.
- Neither end has an entry naming `resolveWritePackageScope` or the new module. The `catch` guards registry reads (`registry.getPackage`), not an engine call the list enumerates.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first.

**How it was built.** Base `77dc7062e5` and head `c5f1351978` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119).

For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

The `.d.ts` was measured twice: on the pre-merge tree, and after merging `main` (head `f4eb4330f3`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119). The readings below hold for both. The base `.d.ts` differs from cut 18's readings because #26305 landed in between.

- **Raw sha256**: `a8f6adb6f9c56b8f441b7224ca8c4d43b84891bce0373446e1577a7884079dd8` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 776,660 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. The member stays a `private NAME;` line.
- **Normalised sha256**: `f7f9306ed46a5605c5e4c59bbc212a7d5288061760ec85d473d2f3047a836ba5` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**:
  - `index.js` hashes `4f35935b2eaf7f2b…` at base and `9495894cdf5ce39b…` at head.
  - The `.call(host` site of `resolveWritePackageScope` occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
  - `function resolveWritePackageScope(` appears 0 times at base and once at head.
- **Positive control** on the head tree: `private` was dropped from `resolveWritePackageScope` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `cf7f37aa818a9795…` (normalised `a7662435fc695cad…`) and print `resolveWritePackageScope(packageId: string | null | undefined): { packageId: string; dependencies: string[]; } | undefined;`. So the bar can see a change on this member.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither the moved function nor `WritePackageScopeHost` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Body, by AST token.** The compare uses the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped. It covers the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. Base `protocol.ts` at `77dc7062e5` is compared against the head module:

```
resolveWritePackageScope: base tokens 252, head tokens 252, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=252 differ=0 members=1
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=300 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=1 other=[]
TOP base=247 head=248 byte-identical=247
```

**Negative control.** One token was changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`if (dep === packageId ||` to `if (dep !== packageId ||`, one occurrence):

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-package-scope.ts "if (dep === packageId ||" -> "if (dep !== packageId ||"
resolveWritePackageScope: base tokens 252, head tokens 252, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
TOTAL tokens=252 differ=1 members=1
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 300 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. The stub sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 247 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +96 / −38 over 2 files, 134 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 150–200). `protocol-write-package-scope.ts` has 88 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

I grepped every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path (70 files) for the member name and for its body's text (`getPackage`, `frontier`, the `catch` comment). I also grepped every test file in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/qa/`.

- **By path: none reads the moved body.** Thirteen of them match `getPackage`, but as a registry test double (`getPackage: () => undefined` and the like) or a direct registry call (`package-dependencies-patch.integration.test.ts`), not as the moved text.
- **Comment-only mentions, no edit owed.** `protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts` (line 228), `packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts` (line 130) and `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` (line 272) name the method in comments. It still exists, on the class.
- **The `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledger.** `packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json` (`dependencies` row) carries the evidence pointer `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope (\`const declared = manifest?.dependencies\` inside the frontier loop …)`.
  - `check:liveness` checks that the `#symbol` is named in the file. The method is still declared in `protocol.ts`, so the pointer resolves and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` exits 0 at head.
  - The quoted line itself now lives in `protocol-write-package-scope.ts`. That is the same state cut 14 left `seed.json`'s `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` pointer in.
  - Re-pointing the row is a `packages/spec/**` edit, which this card does not make. It is disclosed here and in the report as a follow-up.
- No hit in `docs/qa/`.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 with identical output at both ends.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`). It exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13956 → 13926, 13981 → 13951).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,743 at base and 3,745 at head. One of the +2 is the new file; the other is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `77dc7062e5`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register, so this is NOT governed. It has 134 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output. It covers the whole touched package, which has no `lint` script; these are the root `lint` script's flags.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Both runs used vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock, with `VERDICT command-exit 0` on both legs. They ran on the pre-merge tree; the merge changed no file of the package.
  - Base `77dc7062e5`: 21,568 tests (21,549 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 270 files.
  - Head `c5f1351978`: 21,568 tests (21,549 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 270 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `77dc7062e5` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 51 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `f4eb4330f3`. All 51 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
  - The derivation flags the tree as behind `main` only for `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/plugin-grid.json`, which feeds none of these 51 families. The list is the same 51 as cut 18's, so `main` was not merged again.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` exits 0 at head (see the liveness ledger above).

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 18. These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
